'''Quintana Trill''', known as '''Quinta''' to her fans, was a [[Holodrama/Legends|holofilm]] [[Actor/Legends|actress]]. She starred in ''[[Denizens of Dakaret IX]]'', and her arrival at the [[Imperial Cavalcade of Stars]] was reported on by [[Morgraine Delefrenquin]].<ref name="GFT" />
